title: AP2 v0.2 mandate lifecycle (open and closed mandates, presentation and receipts)

states.label: Mandate Content drafted
states.note: Unsigned content built by the Shopping Agent: closed (exact checkout and payment) or open (constraints plus the agent key in cnf).

states.label: Open mandate signed
states.note: vct mandate.checkout.open.1 or mandate.payment.open.1, signed by the user or a trusted agent provider. Bound to the agent key, not to a transaction.

states.label: Closed mandate signed
states.note: vct mandate.checkout.1 or mandate.payment.1. Bound to one checkout through checkout_hash and transaction_id; agent-signed closed mandates carry sd_hash over the open parent.

states.label: Presented to a verifier
states.note: Merchant, Credential Provider, Network or processor. The agent must not present another closed mandate from the same open mandate until it holds an error receipt.

states.label: Accepted (receipt status Success)
states.note: Signed Payment or Checkout Receipt whose reference is the hash of the closed mandate.

states.label: Rejected, fallback possible
states.note: unresolved_constraint or mandates_not_supported: a signal to fall back to a user-approved closed mandate or a non-agentic flow.

states.label: Open mandate narrowed or used up
states.note: The agent stores the open, closed and receipt tuple and reduces the open mandate's scope; payment.budget and payment.agent_recurrence allow bounded reuse.

states.label: Purchase evidence stored
states.note: Both mandates and both receipts can later be checked by a dispute verifier.

states.label: Expired
states.note: exp passed. v0.2 defines no revocation, so expiry is the only built-in end for an open mandate.

transitions.trigger: User approves constraints on the Trusted Surface
transitions.apiCall: Trusted Surface signs with user_sk (or OpenID4VP transaction_data type delegate)
transitions.specRef: flows.md Human Not Present, Phase 1a step 4

transitions.trigger: User approves the exact checkout on the Trusted Surface
transitions.apiCall: Trusted Surface signs mandate.checkout.1 and mandate.payment.1 with user_sk

transitions.trigger: Agent finds a checkout that fits the constraints
transitions.apiCall: Agent signs a key-binding JWT with the key in cnf (sd_hash over the open mandate)
transitions.specRef: flows.md Human Not Present, Phase 2 step 2

transitions.apiCall: Payment Mandate to the Credential Provider; Checkout Mandate with the token to the Merchant

transitions.trigger: Verifier checks chain, bindings and constraints
Constraint cannot be confirmed, unknown constraint, or mandates not used
transitions.apiCall: Receipt JWT with status Error, error unresolved_constraint or mandates_not_supported

transitions.trigger: Signature or chain fails, or the mandate does not approve the action
transitions.apiCall: Receipt JWT with status Error, error invalid_credential or invalid_mandate

transitions.trigger: Fallback: user brought back to approve a closed mandate
transitions.apiCall: New request to the Trusted Surface

transitions.trigger: Agent may try a different closed mandate from the same open mandate
transitions.apiCall: Error receipt held by the agent

transitions.trigger: Success receipt for an agent-signed mandate
transitions.apiCall: Agent stores open, closed and receipt tuple
Payment Receipt from the processor, Checkout Receipt from the Merchant

transitions.trigger: Budget or recurrence still allows another purchase
transitions.apiCall: payment.budget and payment.agent_recurrence evaluated against earlier presentations
